cs.t: You don't need to go Toto. There are Korean companies that make bidets that (in my opinion) are just as good, but are more affordable. Bio Bidet is one of them (BB1000). Stateside, there's Brondell (I recommend the Swash1000) but my preference is for Bio Bidet.
cs.th: Japanese Toilets: The Future Called 30 Years Ago
